name: Belle II
summary: Belle II is located at SuperKEKB, KEK, Tsukuba, Ibaraki. This second-generation B-factory detector has dedicated dark-sector and low-multiplicity physics working groups.
detection_principle: Known initial states in e⁺e⁻ collisions enable missing-mass/energy analyses for dimuons accompanied by invisible Z′ bosons, low-multiplicity dark sectors and long-lived decays.

status.label: 2019–2021 data used in multiple dark-sector searches

results.summary: The dimuon plus missing-energy search sets 90% confidence upper limits on production and coupling of invisible Lμ−Lτ Z′ bosons.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
